title: The Thread Cannot Be Recut
prompt: Reshaping a string never changes the original — it spins a NEW thread. Predict what stays.

rounds.explain: .upper() does not change the original — it makes a NEW string. word is still 'fire'; big is 'FIRE'. Strings never change in place.
You didn't edit the old string — you built a new one ('hi!') and pointed word at it. That is how strings 'grow'.
